title: Human Reproduction and Reproductive Health
summary: Male and female reproductive systems, fertilisation, the placenta, development of the baby, and reproductive health.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT: How do Organisms Reproduce?

objectives: I can describe the main organs of the male and female reproductive systems and their jobs.
I can describe fertilisation, implantation and the role of the placenta.
I can explain why reproductive health matters.
misconceptions: The mother's and baby's blood mix in the placenta.
Reproductive health is only an adult topic.
